create_cifar10_dataset: create a Cifar10 dataset instance with a data path and train or test split
load_cifar10_data: load CIFAR-10 data batches from pickle files into memory as numpy arrays
prepare_cifar10_image: prepare a CIFAR-10 image by normalizing per channel and applying random flip and crop
get_cifar10_item: get a single CIFAR-10 image and label by index from the dataset
review_cifar10_class: review the Cifar10 class and its data loading and image preparation methods
